hero.heading: Who we are
hero.lede: Take 3 was built around a simple idea: great talent deserves great representation, and great booking comes from knowing your people.

story.imageAlt: Three of the Take 3 team in a white studio: two in black Crew t-shirts carrying a camera rig and a reflector, one in workout gear
story.caption: Tyler hosting our first training session back in early 2019.
paragraphs: Our team brings together experience from across performance, production and the wider creative industries, giving us an understanding of both sides of the booking process. We know what our artists need, we understand what our clients are looking for, and we know how to bring the two together.

As a close-knit team, we share knowledge, communicate quickly and adapt to the demands of an industry that rarely stands still. Every artist in our books is met by us in person, meaning our bookers know the talent they’re putting forward - their skills, their experience and, importantly, who they are.
It’s a personal approach to talent management, backed by industry knowledge and a team that knows how to get things done.

items.title: We know our talent
items.detail: We’ve met the artists, we understand their abilities beyond a list of credits, and can confidently recommend the right person for the brief.

items.title: We understand the brief
items.detail: We understand production, performance and specialist skills, and what you actually need - including when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.

items.title: We make it happen
items.detail: A small, connected team means quick communication, flexibility and problem-solving. When briefs change, numbers increase or production needs someone at short notice, we can respond.

slots.text: Nothing seems to phase Tyler and his team whenever I message them with a random request, at weekends or at 11pm at night when my brain is on one and I have an idea about the type of person I want to find.
slots.name: Annie Hitchcock

slots.text: The best thing though is that Tyler and Chanel understand instantly not only the type of talent I’m looking for but always connect me to artists who really enhance the creative process. This type of instinct doesn’t come along very often in our industry.
slots.name: Jason Gilkinson

slots.text: Every production that I’m lucky enough to have Take 3 on board, I am honestly enamoured by their professionalism. I trust Tyler, Chanel and the team implicitly, and for that I am eternally grateful.
slots.name: Rhiannon Mobbs

slots.text: Take 3’s artists always manage to deliver. Punctual, friendly and always happy to get stuck in on set. And Chanel and Tyler are always there to help with even the trickiest briefs. What more could you ask for?
slots.name: Katie Hodgson

slots.text: The team at Take 3 have been by my side on many weird and wonderful casting adventures since 2023, and honestly, I don’t know how I’d do it without them. No matter how big, small, or slightly unhinged the request, I know I can rely on Take 3.
slots.name: Stephanie Bradshaw

slots.text: Having worked with Tyler and his team for the past five years, I can confidently attest to the care they take in casting performers who are perfectly suited to each brief.
slots.name: Camilla Southwell
